en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large stone arch bridge with multiple spans crossing a deep valley. Pedestrians are visible on the bridge and old-style street lamps line the parapet. In the background, a townscape with multi‑storey houses and a notable central building with a small tower is visible. The printed captions at the top read "Bautzen." on the left and "Kronprinzenbrücke." on the right.
